mapper.select: SELECT keyword, search_count, last_searched_at FROM vw_search_popular_keyword ORDER BY search_count DESC, last_searched_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT keyword, count(*) AS search_count, max(created_at) AS last_searched_at FROM log_search_keyword WHERE is_blocked = false AND created_at >= #{fromTs} GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY search_count DESC, last_searched_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT keyword, max(created_at) AS last_searched_at FROM log_search_keyword WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_blocked = false AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY last_searched_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT keyword, max(created_at) AS last_searched_at FROM log_search_keyword WHERE created_ip = #{clientIp} AND is_blocked = false AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY last_searched_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', created_at), 'MM-DD') AS key, count(*) AS count FROM log_search_keyword WHERE created_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('day', created_at)

SELECT keyword AS key, count(*) AS count FROM log_search_keyword WHERE result_count = 0 AND is_blocked = false AND created_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY count DESC, key LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_blocked) AS blocked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result_count = 0 AND NOT is_blocked) AS noresult FROM log_search_keyword WHERE created_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days})
